facts.fact: Ethio telecom says that in its reporting period it deployed 793 km of new backbone fibre, bringing its national backbone network to 23,442.1 km (regions served not listed); no date given, so the article's published date is used.

note: Horizon corridor (Djibouti-Ethiopia-Sudan-Jeddah) is a cross-border route, not stated as part of the national backbone, so no building fact.
